description: This file defines the Customer controller class for the OpenCart admin module. It handles customer management functionalities such as listing, editing, creating, deleting customers, and associated operations like login, authorization, history, transactions, rewards, IP addresses, and related data. It interacts with models to retrieve and manipulate customer data and renders views for the admin interface.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class managing customer CRUD, login, status updates, history, transactions, rewards, IPs, authorizations, and related operations within the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load customer list view with filters and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the customer list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the customer list data, including filtering, sorting, pagination, and view rendering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the customer detail form for create or update.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving customer data (create/update) with validation.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Resets login attempts for a specific customer email.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected customers.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected customers.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected customers.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Creates a login token and redirects to customer account login.

methods.name: payment
methods.description: Displays customer payment/subscription methods.

methods.name: getPayment
methods.description: Fetches and prepares customer payment/subscription data for view.

methods.name: deletePayment
methods.description: Deletes a customer payment/subscription record.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays customer history logs.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and formats customer history logs with pagination.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds an entry to customer history logs.

methods.name: transaction
methods.description: Displays customer financial transactions.

methods.name: getTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves customer transaction data.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a new financial transaction for the customer.

methods.name: reward
methods.description: Displays customer reward points and history.

methods.name: getReward
methods.description: Retrieves and formats reward data.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds reward points for the customer.

methods.name: ip
methods.description: Shows IP address logs associated with the customer.

methods.name: getIp
methods.description: Fetches and formats IP address logs.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Displays client authorization records for the customer.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves and formats OAuth authorizations.

methods.name: deleteAuthorize
methods.description: Deletes a specific authorization record.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides customer data for autocomplete functionality.

methods.name: customfield
methods.description: Returns custom field definitions for customer groups.
